nl.bodyHtml:
Error- en access-logs in CyberPanel/OLS vertellen waarom een site 500 geeft of welke IP brute-forcet. Zoek op tijdstip van het incident.

Vinden

  • Website → Logs / Error Log in CyberPanel.
  • File Manager: logpaden onder de vhost indien getoond.
  • PHP errors vs OLS errors onderscheiden.

Lezen

  1. Filter op timestamp rond de fout.
  2. Noteer rule-ID (ModSec) of PHP stacktrace.
  3. Voeg relevante regels toe aan je supportticket.

Heb je na het volgen van deze stappen nog vragen? Neem contact op met TripleZero iT support via het ticketssysteem. Vermeld hostname, CyberPanel-URL en wat je precies ziet (foutmelding of screenshot).

Gerelateerd: ModSecurity; 503/508; PHP-extensies.

This guide covers Error- and access-logs find and lezen in CyberPanel. You work in CyberPanel, focusing on error, access, logs — not unrelated side quests in other menus.

Preparation

  • Access to CyberPanel
  • Focus of this article: error, access, logs
  • Note of the current setting/status

Steps

  1. Open CyberPanel and look specifically for settings around error, access, logs.
  2. Select the correct website in CyberPanel.
  3. Open SSL, DNS, Email, File Manager or Backup — focused on error.
  4. Apply the access update; purge OLS cache if the site shows stale content.
  5. Check Error Logs if you get 500/white screen after the change.
  6. Isolate: does it work elsewhere (other network, webmail vs client, staging vs live) for error, access, logs?
  7. Correlate with the last change; roll back or fix one cause at a time.

Verify

  • Result for error, access, logs matches “Error- and access-logs find and lezen in CyberPanel”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside error en access logs
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get error, access, logs right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if error, access, logs touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: CyberPanel, backups, tickets.
